Definition: from G2596 and G916; to impose upon:--burden.
BiblicalUsage: Paul tells the Corinthians he would not burden them, refusing to use his place among them to weigh them down.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a true servant never makes himself a burden on the people he was sent to serve.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
